definitions.explanation: Free from impurity or contamination, whether physical (clear water, clean air) or moral/spiritual (pure heart, innocent character). Has an elevated, literary tone.

examples.japanese: {清|きよ}らかな⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{清|きよ}らかな⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by her pure singing voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{清|きよ}らかな⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Deep in the mountains, clean air and beautiful nature remain.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat elevated word. More poetic and formal than ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な (clean, pretty). Often used in descriptions of nature, spiritual contexts, and literary prose.

Related to the verb ⟦{清|きよ}める→清める：13340_kiyomeru⟧ (to purify) and the noun {清|きよ}さ (purity/cleanliness).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清|きよ}らかな⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧: pure water
- {清|きよ}らかな⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧: pure heart
- {清|きよ}らかな⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: clean air
- {清|きよ}らかな⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧: clear stream
